theorem_title: Six logarithmic intervals with exact 22-digit rational endpoints
natural_language_statement: Certifies both endpoints of six exact rational intervals for the natural logarithms of 2, 29/16, 232/231, 464/463, 32 theta, and 2(1-theta), where theta=0.040409899 is the published fixed parameter. Every interval has denominator 10^22 and width 10^(-22). The endpoints are exactly those displayed in the formal statement; no rounding or numerical oracle is a hypothesis.
